label: Why t replaces z
subgoals: Estimate the standard error with s
Count n minus one degrees of freedom

visual.title: The t interval has heavier tails
visual.caption: With a small sample the standard error is estimated by s. The t distribution has heavier tails than the normal, so the same confidence level needs a larger critical value and gives a wider interval.

predict.question: Why is a 95 percent t interval wider than a 95 percent z interval?
options: The t critical value is larger
The t interval uses a smaller confidence level
The t statistic is always negative
predict.explain: The t critical value at 9 degrees of freedom is about 2.262, above the normal 1.96. The larger multiplier widens the interval.
